trailhead.label: Malga Sass car park, Valfloriana, the APT’s start

cautions: A gravel forest road and a grassy path; the road may see the odd forestry vehicle.
Mountain meadows where cattle may graze in summer: keep your dog on the lead and close.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
